title: Leo vs Scorpio — Something Big Is Coming
script_text: Get ready, Leo and Scorpio—the stars ignite a love you can't ignore! Leo's fire meets Scorpio's water like a blaze meeting an ocean. The currents nourish and dampen, but trust is the bridge. Leo's Venus seeks grand gestures while Scorpio's Mars craves depth. The spark is intense, yet each feels the other's love language alien. Leo's warmth meets Scorpio's intensity, creating a dazzling romance that can blind both. Mercury in Gemini sparkles, while Scorpio's Mercury in Virgo dissects nuance, leaving both unheard. Misunderstandings flare when Leo assumes agreement and Scorpio reads hidden motives. Saturn at 21° Libra squares Leo's Sun in the 10th House, urging Leo to curb career drives and accept slower progress. A trine to Scorpio's Pluto in the 7th House nurtures bonding, turning challenges into transformative growth. The secret? Let Leo's confidence melt Scorpio's walls without demanding instant vulnerability. Comment your partner's sign!
